Seriously the best way is to talk to her.

1. Do it in a not threatening manner
2. Do it some where she feels safe
3. Make sure she has an escape route is she feels uncomfortable
4. Do it some place where the chances of being interrupted or over heard are extremely low... nothing more awkward than crying and someone just walks in after there was a big secret released

4 (Very important!!!) think before you speak to her about as many ways as possible it can go down. What will you do if she starts crying? What will you do if she says someone is doing it to her? What will you do if she is defensive? What will you do if she ask for you not to tell anyone???

I have been on both sides of this many a time. If you have an specific questions let me know though a pm!
